data.narrative:
Stark Defence is a Series A-stage defense and security company founded by Florian Seibel, Uwe Horstmann, and Johannes Schaback, having raised $100M+ to date. The valuation analysis draws from a peer universe of 10 same-sector and adjacent-stage companies, comprising 8 private firms (including Anduril Industries, Helsing, and Shield AI) and 2 public comparables (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS).

Stage-progression methodology was not applicable; the stated $4.0B post-money valuation appears to be a data-quality issue, as it would imply a multiple exceeding 20x total raised capital. Peer-median analysis, the primary applicable method, anchors valuation to 10 defense-sector peers spanning Series A and Series B stages. The peer cohort shows a median valuation of $1.0B with a range from $125M to $3.0B. Sampled peers include Dream Security ($3.0B Series B), Harmattan AI ($1.4B Series B), Code Metal ($1.2B Series B), and Castelion and Defense Unicorns (both $1.0B Series B).

The triangulation supports a valuation range of $850M to $1.1B, centered at $1.0B. Key uncertainties include differentiation within the defense-tech sector, revenue traction relative to peer benchmarks, and customer concentration. The single-method reliance reflects limited data availability on earlier-stage private comparable transactions.
